about: Every source the harness atlas reads, with the source_policy.json role that grants it, its root, one exact path, what is read and the trigger that makes it present. Repository records reuse the existing Architecture and overview grants; the two private projections use the atlas grants only. tools/local-pages/atlas_data.py checks each declaration against its exact grant before any open.

final_stack.reads: layers[] (catalog, layer_id, title, status, winners, survivors), runs[] (id, pin) and index.by_repository; layer states and the FINAL count follow tools/local-pages/architecture_manifest.py layer_manifest()
final_stack.trigger: scripts/final_stack.py writes the file at a merged commit

foundation_catalog.reads: layers[] order, titles and requirement text of the foundation catalog
foundation_catalog.trigger: the foundation landscape catalog is committed

trading_catalog.reads: layers[] order and titles of the trading catalog, for the layer states
trading_catalog.trigger: the trading landscape catalog is committed

evidence_matrix.reads: the per-layer convergence conditions layer_manifest() needs for each state
evidence_matrix.trigger: scripts/component_matrix.py writes the matrix at a merged commit

cc_slots.reads: slots[] (id, status, default cut to its first clause) for the Claude cells and the stacks
cc_slots.trigger: the claude-native-practice skill commits its slot table

skill_manifest.reads: skills[] rows (name, source, ref, tree_sha, skill_md_sha256, status) of the skills the atlas names
skill_manifest.trigger: the pinned skill manifest is committed
